thread:
ian.finance: Heads up  Aurora Labs flagged their May bill. They paid INV-5602 but say reserved commit didn't apply; invoice lists reserve lines but metering shows zero committed usage. Theyre asking for reconciliation and a ledger note for auditors.
maya.ops: Can ops paste provisioning audit + the billing snapshot?
billing-bot: Invoice INV-5602: https://invoices.redwood/INV-5602.pdf
billing-bot: Metering summary: customer_id=cust_aurora, committed_hours=0, burst_tokens=1,145,600, reserved_tag_state=attached, tag_applied_at=2026-07-01T00:30:10Z, billing_snapshot=2026-07-01T00:15:00Z
oliver.sales: Contract AUR-3G-2026 had reserved start 2026-07-01 00:00 UTC. Onboarding wrote a tag but looks like it landed after snapshot.
ian.finance: Quick estimate: burst billed $11,456 vs reserved expected $6,000. Delta = $5,456. Options: (1) retro allocate and reissue invoice (needs legal), (2) operational credit ~ $5.5k, or (3) partial credit + ledger note. Need revenue approval.
serena.revenue: Customer preference? If they want a corrected invoice for auditors we'll do it, but prefer credit for speed. Approve up to $6,000 credit conditional on ops remediation and postmortem.
maya.ops: Root cause: provisioning webhook retried late due to transient DB lock during midnight job churn. We'll add a small sleep and idempotency guard; runbook entry to be added. Running query now:
```
SELECT customer_id, event_time, reserved_tag_state, billing_snapshot_time
FROM provisioning.audit
WHERE customer_id='cust_aurora' AND date(event_time)='2026-07-01';
```
maya.ops: Query output: event_time=2026-07-01T00:30:10Z, reserved_tag_state=active, billing_snapshot_time=2026-07-01T00:15:00Z
ian.finance: Serena please reply with "approve" to allow finance to book the operational credit and create ADJ-2026-688. Also ops ETA for fix?
oliver.sales: CS says Aurora prefers a ledger note and credit; I'll send the message. Draft: "We identified a provisioning timing issue that prevented your reserved commit from being applied at billing snapshot. We've applied a one-time credit of $6,000 and attached a ledger note for your auditors. We've also fixed the provisioning timing and added a runbook."
serena.revenue: approve
ian.finance: Creating ledger adjustment ADJ-2026-688 | amount: -6000 | reason: operational_timing_credit | linked_invoice: INV-5602. Finance will attach ops runbook link.
billing-bot: Ledger entry created: ADJ-2026-688 | customer: cust_aurora | amount: -6000 | reason: operational_timing_credit | linked_invoice: INV-5602
maya.ops: Fix merged, adding idempotency guard and 30s delay window. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/prov-timing-guard. Will post postmortem tomorrow.
oliver.sales: Customer notified and accepted credit. CS asked to confirm that corrected invoice not required.
ian.finance: Closing loop. Finance booked adjustment and attached ledger note. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
